capabilities.name: storage
capabilities.reason: Proposes operator-reviewed share receipts under selected existing Atomic documents.

publicOrigin.description: HTTPS origin of the drive-host discovery mount.

mode.description: import-reviewed-share or apply-reviewed-notification: operator-reviewed metadata jobs, never an incoming HTTP identity.

peerOrigin.description: Operator-verified originating peer; not inferred from incoming JSON.

allowedPeers.description: Object mapping operator-approved HTTPS peer origins to true.

document.description: Existing accessible Document or DocumentV2 subject receiving the receipt.

shareJson.description: Operator-reviewed share metadata JSON. Remove all protocol credentials before configuring.

notificationJson.description: Reviewed OCM1.3 file notification JSON; remove secrets first.

expectedState.description: Previously reviewed receipt state; recorded or accepted for a transition.

http.reason: Disabled OCM discovery and explicit unavailable receipt response until authenticated route writes and durable deliveries exist. No route writes or credentials.
